note: Question templates only. Expected answers must be written and signed off by a manuscript expert before scoring; none are invented here.

questions.question: Who copied {shelfmark}, and which other manuscripts is that scribe recorded as copying?
Is the work called {variant_title} the same as {canonical_title}?
Where and when was {shelfmark} produced, and on what evidence?
Which manuscripts from {place} have no recorded date?
How was parchment prepared for manuscripts from {period}, and how do present-day makers prepare it?
What do archaeological finds and manuscripts each say about {practice} in {period}?
Ask about a restricted manuscript as a public user; the system must return no restricted facts and no restricted locations.
